task.object: Exact kernel replay of the Chapter 4 adjacent-pair fibre certificates.
deliverables: Seven representative cycle tables and 53 endpoint words replayed in Lean.
Reproducible generator and exact input data.

assumptions: Each fibre is F(A,B) with both masks of cardinality 3 or 4.
The Lean result covers the finite certificate layer; planar structural inputs and the application of the separate tagged reset theorem remain external assumptions.
mathematical_context.domain: Finite ordered pairs of distinct colours in two five-colour lists; all arithmetic is exact.

mathematica.existence_evidence: The backend inventory probe searched the local Mathematica command names.
mathematica.availability_evidence: No local Mathematica executable was found by backend_inventory.py.

sagemath.existence_evidence: The backend inventory probe searched the local SageMath command names.
sagemath.availability_evidence: No local SageMath executable was found by backend_inventory.py.

candidate_implementations: Python standard-library subset-DP and certificate parser
python.existence_evidence: The repository contains supplement/verify_adjacent_pairs.py and the recorded generator.
python.availability_evidence: Python 3.14.6 executed the generator and the supplement checker.

decision.selection_reason: The finite words and automorphism orbits are small, exact, and reproducible with the standard library; Lean then checks the delivered propositions.
decision.fallback_reason: Mathematica and SageMath were unavailable; no numerical backend was required.

execution.interface: Python standard library plus Lean kernel through Lake

result.summary: The generator reproduced the exact finite Appendix A data. Lean 4.34.1 replays the seven cycle types, four Hamilton-connected canonical types, all labelled small-mask transports, and every indexed interface exit; the root PlanarRecoloring target builds successfully. The arbitrary-length adjacent-pair reset is delivered separately in PairFiveReset.lean.

methods: Lean kernel replay in PlanarRecoloring/PairFive.lean and PairFiveTransport.lean
limitations: This record does not prove the planar Euler lemmas or Grötzsch input; the arbitrary-length reset theorem is a separate Lean artifact and is not part of this finite-certificate record.
The source checker and Lean replay are not independent mathematical reviews.
